name: Itou Shino
source: The wife of the director of Ocean Land. After hearing Sakurai's intention to remain open he sends Shino to work for them explaining that they need all the help they can get. Although Shino agrees to work as a waitress at Sakurai she feels funny about acting as a spy even when asked to by her husband.
